source_refs.note: 3. Genetics and genomics: a main subheading of 22.1.2 Applications of Biostatistics, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 188-188.

blocks.text: The field of genetics and genomics relies heavily on biostatistics to analyze complex genetic data. This includes uncovering relationships between genes and diseases, understanding inheritance patterns, and exploring genetic variations. Biostatistical methods are essential in personalized medicine, where treatments are tailored to an individual's genetic profile to enhance effectiveness and reduce adverse effects.
